title: Jaime M NDE 3497
content: My cardiologist ordered me to undergo an outpatient catheterization on Wednesday, January 30. I entered the hospital at 11.30am and the doctor administered local anesthesia to my right groin and started to work with his instruments. As he did so, we were having a normal conversation. Yet, in an instant, I found myself on a patio of a two-story house and at the bottom, about 30 meters below, there were many people - there must have been 50 - and they were all very happy. They were listening to party music and they all chanted my name: "Jaime, Jaime". It seemed to be a "welcome" party. The place was very beautiful with much light. I was imbued with a sense of fortune and happiness that I'd never before felt with such intensity. It was, without doubt, the most pleasant sensation of my life. The feeling of being welcomed was the strongest I’ve ever experienced in my life. I was able to recognize my deceased mother among all those people, but when I advanced towards her, I felt my chest burn with the electric shock of 300 joules [from a defibrillator]. I returned to the operating room. I asked the doctor what had happened and he said I'd had a small cardiac arrest, normal in my condition, as they uncapped the vein during the rapid resuscitation.

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: Found himself on a patio of a two-story house, with people about 30 meters below.

arrival.other_being_detail: Many people (about 50) at what seemed like a welcome party, chanting his name.

environment.environment_other_detail: Patio of a two-story house; party music; many happy people chanting his name.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Outpatient cardiac catheterization; small cardiac arrest during procedure; defibrillated (300 joules).

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Welcome-party setting with about 50 people chanting his name; return triggered by defibrillator shock sensation.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Abrupt shift from procedure to a beautiful patio scene (no tunnel); then immediate return with defibrillation shock.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Perceived the return as a chest-burning electric shock of 300 joules from a defibrillator while approaching his deceased mother.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "It seemed to be a 'welcome' party."; "The feeling of being welcomed was the strongest I’ve ever experienced in my life."; "I felt my chest burn with the electric shock of 300 joules [from a defibrillator]."
